latest_release.name: v4.5.0
latest_release.body:
Omarchy 4.5 (aka Quattro RS!) is the first big feature release since [Quattro](https://github.com/omacom/omarchy/releases/tag/v4.0.0), and it’s a whopper: over 740 pull requests merged from more than 180 contributors in just twelve weeks. It now offers a traditional desktop mode next to the tiling default. You can install it natively on a M1/M2/M3/Neo MacBooks. And it speaks 50 languages. And a gazillion other features, fixes, and improvements.

Release notes: https://omarchy.org/news/2026/11/omarchy-4-5/

hot_issues.title: 4.0.1: `shell_succeeds` fix enables NVDEC VAAPI routing on hybrid laptops with Intel-driven displays, corrupting browser video
Update/reboot left keyring in invalid state, browser sessions and gh auth got cleared
Camera (IPU7-PTL / OV08X40) on ThinkPad X1 Carbon Gen 14: ACPI status=0, sensor invisible to Linux
Black image on resume from suspend (sometimes ~60s freeze) after 3.7 kernel bump to 7.0
Lock shell dies during normal idle->lock; session permanently locked, reboot required

discussions.title: Native & Robust AppImage Management (Portable-by-click, Sandboxing, Snapshots, and libfuse fix)
macOS guest VMs under KVM on Omarchy M (Apple Silicon): working, with a clean GPU desktop
Optional safe start volume for every output when it connects or becomes the default
Restore floating windows when the only monitor disconnects and comes back (TV standby)
Command Bar - One shortcut (Super + .) for windows, conversions, emoji, processes, and more
Feature request: allow password syncing with iCloud Passwords
Suggestion: Offer smoother touchpad workspace swiping
Make "individual worskapaces per monitor" an option!
